items.q: So there was Harold Arlen and Ethel Waters and all of those great stars.

ctx.x: Now we're talking about New York.
In New York, yes. So there was Harold Arlen and Ethel Waters and all of those great stars. The show was really terrific. It was a terrific show.
WILLARD: And so Duke's band played all the music for the show?
